001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j;
002
003import java.util.Locale;
004
005import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
006import org.slf4j.ILoggerFactory;
007import org.slf4j.IMarkerFactory;
008import org.slf4j.helpers.BasicMarkerFactory;
009import org.slf4j.spi.MDCAdapter;
010import org.slf4j.spi.SLF4JServiceProvider;
011
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
014import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
015
016/**
017 * SLF4J provider using RainbowGum.
018 */
019@ServiceProvider(SLF4JServiceProvider.class)
020public class RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider implements SLF4JServiceProvider {
021
022        /**
023         * Declare the version of the SLF4J API this implementation is compiled against. The
024         * value of this field is modified with each major release.
025         */
026        private static final String REQUESTED_API_VERSION = "2.0";
027
028        /**
029         * The name this module looks up in {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry}
030         * (keyed by {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory}) for an optional factory
031         * whose {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory#defaultKeyValues()} is merged as
032         * the lowest-precedence source underneath MDC for every event this module builds -
033         * MDC's own key values, and anything a fluent builder's own {@code addKeyValue(...)}
034         * adds on top, always win on a key collision. Entirely optional: if nothing is
035         * registered under this name (the default, and the overwhelming majority of setups),
036         * behavior is unchanged - just MDC, as always.
037         * @apiNote provisional - reusing the existing {@code LogEventFactory} extension point
038         * directly rather than introducing a dedicated SPI type for this specific purpose,
039         * for now.
040         */
041        public static final String SCOPED_KEY_VALUES_SERVICE_NAME = "scopedKeyValues";
042
043        /**
044         * Which {@link RainbowGumMDCAdapter} implementation to use - {@code THREAD_LOCAL}
045         * (the default) is today's existing {@link ArrayMDCAdapter} behavior; {@code NOOP}
046         * swaps in a {@link NoopMDCAdapter} instead, whose every method is a
047         * no-op/empty-returning stub that never touches either of {@link ArrayMDCAdapter}'s
048         * {@link ThreadLocal} fields - for deployments that want a hard guarantee of no
049         * {@link ThreadLocal} anywhere in the logging path and are fine losing MDC entirely
050         * to get it. Kept as a type rather than an enabled/disabled toggle so a future third
051         * implementation - e.g. one backed by {@code ScopedValue} instead of
052         * {@link ThreadLocal}, once that's a viable MDC storage strategy - can be added
053         * without a breaking property-format change.
054         */
055        enum MDCType {
056
057                /**
058                 * MDC works normally - {@link ArrayMDCAdapter}'s existing
059                 * {@link ThreadLocal}-backed behavior, unchanged.
060                 */
061                THREAD_LOCAL,
062                /**
063                 * MDC is completely turned off - {@link NoopMDCAdapter} is used instead of
064                 * {@link ArrayMDCAdapter}.
065                 */
066                NOOP;
067
068                static MDCType parse(String value) {
069                        return MDCType.valueOf(value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
070                }
071
072        }
073
074        /**
075         * {@code logging.mdc.type} - {@code THREAD_LOCAL} (default) or {@code NOOP}. Read
076         * once, during {@link #initialize(RainbowGum)}, since
077         * {@link #RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider()} (called by
078         * {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}) runs before any {@link RainbowGum} (and therefore
079         * any properties) exist yet.
080         */
081        static final String LOGGING_MDC_TYPE_PROPERTY = "logging.mdc.type";
082
083        /**
084         * {@code logging.global.threadlocalDisabled} - {@code core}'s
085         * {@code LogProperties#GLOBAL_THREADLOCAL_DISABLED_PROPERTY}, read independently here
086         * (that constant is package-private in a different module, not exposed for reuse)
087         * since it forces MDC off too, the same way it forces every appender off
088         * {@link ThreadLocal}-backed types - see that property's javadoc for why this is two
089         * independent readers of the same property key rather than one shared flag.
090         */
091        static final String GLOBAL_THREADLOCAL_DISABLED_PROPERTY = "logging.global.threadlocalDisabled";
092
093        /*
094         * TRUE/FALSE rather than .ofBoolean() - a typo'd value fails loudly through the
095         * existing Property/Result machinery instead of silently resolving to "not disabled".
096         * Mirrors core's identically-named-in-spirit LogConfig.ThreadLocalDisabled - each
097         * module parses this shared property key independently, see
098         * GLOBAL_THREADLOCAL_DISABLED_PROPERTY above.
099         */
100        private enum GlobalThreadLocalDisabled {
101
102                TRUE, FALSE;
103
104                static GlobalThreadLocalDisabled parse(String value) {
105                        return GlobalThreadLocalDisabled.valueOf(value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
106                }
107
108        }
109
110        private @Nullable ILoggerFactory loggerFactory;
111
112        private final IMarkerFactory markerFactory;
113
114        /*
115         * Not final: initialize(RainbowGum) may swap this from the default THREAD_LOCAL
116         * instance constructed below to a NOOP one once logging.mdc.type can actually be read
117         * - see that method. Any MDCAdapter method called between construction and
118         * initialize() running (an SLF4J-bootstrap-ordering edge case, not expected in normal
119         * use) still observes the default THREAD_LOCAL instance either way.
120         */
121        private RainbowGumMDCAdapter mdcAdapter;
122
123        /**
124         * No Arg for service laoder.
125         */
126        public RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider() {
127                mdcAdapter = new RainbowGumMDCAdapter();
128                markerFactory = new BasicMarkerFactory();
129        }
130
131        @Override
132        public ILoggerFactory getLoggerFactory() {
133                return require(loggerFactory);
134        }
135
136        @Override
137        public IMarkerFactory getMarkerFactory() {
138                return markerFactory;
139        }
140
141        @Override
142        public MDCAdapter getMDCAdapter() {
143                return mdcAdapter;
144        }
145
146        @Override
147        public String getRequestedApiVersion() {
148                return REQUESTED_API_VERSION;
149        }
150
151        private static <T> T require(@Nullable T factory) {
152                if (factory == null) {
153                        throw new IllegalStateException("slf4j was not initialized correctly");
154                }
155                return factory;
156        }
157
158        @Override
159        public void initialize() {
160                /*
161                 * Make JBoss logging use us
162                 */
163                if (System.getProperty("org.jboss.logging.provider") == null) {
164                        System.setProperty("org.jboss.logging.provider", "slf4j");
165                }
166                RainbowGum rainbowGum = RainbowGum.of();
167                initialize(rainbowGum);
168                System.setProperty("SLF4J_LOGGING_LOADED", "true");
169        }
170
171        /**
172         * For testing Rainbow Gums SLF4J without initializing SLF4J.
173         * @param rainbowGum which gum to use for logger factory.
174         */
175        public void initialize(RainbowGum rainbowGum) {
176                var properties = rainbowGum.config().properties();
177                // shared validator: a mistake in both logging.mdc.type and
178                // logging.global.threadlocalDisabled at once is reported together instead of
179                // only the first one found - both already have .or(default) applied, so
180                // validateIfError (not validate) is correct: Missing can never occur.
181                var validator = LogProperty.Validator.of(RainbowGumSLF4JServiceProvider.class);
182                var typeResult = properties.forKey(LOGGING_MDC_TYPE_PROPERTY)
183                        .ofString()
184                        .map(MDCType::parse)
185                        .or(MDCType.THREAD_LOCAL)
186                        .validateIfError(validator);
187                var globalDisabledResult = properties.forKey(GLOBAL_THREADLOCAL_DISABLED_PROPERTY)
188                        .ofString()
189                        .map(GlobalThreadLocalDisabled::parse)
190                        .or(GlobalThreadLocalDisabled.FALSE)
191                        .validateIfError(validator);
192                validator.validate();
193                var type = typeResult.value();
194                var globalDisabled = globalDisabledResult.value() == GlobalThreadLocalDisabled.TRUE;
195                if (type == MDCType.NOOP || globalDisabled) {
196                        mdcAdapter = new NoopMDCAdapter();
197                }
198                loggerFactory = new RainbowGumLoggerFactory(rainbowGum, mdcAdapter);
199        }
200
201}
